ENCLAVE · LOCAL WALLET HANDOFF · IPNS PUBLISHER RELEASE

Release IPNS Publisher 1.0.6 to the existing deployment

Four MetaMask confirmations from the owner account, in this order:

  1. Sign the upload authorization for the frozen, tested ipns-publisher-ensrepair.wasm (sha256 eaa49323…, 1,428,694 bytes). A signature only: no fee, nothing on chain.
  2. Publish catalog version ipns-publisher:1.0.6 (CID bafybeia2ymbg45…). Its resources, ports and config are version 1.0.5's, unchanged.
  3. Upgrade the existing deployment 0xd9798e4c… from 1.0.5 to 1.0.6. The same deployment and the same IPNS name.
  4. Set that deployment's public config with exactly one change: ipni.announceAllBlocks false → true. Secret references, placement and isolation are unchanged.

Every transaction sends 0 ETH; only the network fee is paid. No new deployment, deposit, transfer or USDC.
